targetEffect.en: An independent Arena panel that keeps sending a right click shows SENT=RIGHT next to GOT. The panel is white while they match and red when GOT is LEFT, after a later switcher toggles mouse-button swap every 2 seconds.
targetEffect.zh-CN: 独立的 Arena 面板持续发送右键，显示 SENT=RIGHT 与 GOT。两者相同时为白，GOT 为 LEFT 时为红。随后切换器每 2 秒对调一次鼠标按键。

reason.en: The recorded desktop panel stayed white with SENT=RIGHT GOT=RIGHT for the complete capture. GOT=LEFT did not appear.
reason.zh-CN: 完整录像里面板保持白色，SENT=RIGHT、GOT=RIGHT，没有出现 GOT=LEFT。

evidence: dsh-20261107T150246-f1d3ed1f recording 68.625s: 2s RGB scan red count 0; panel stays SENT=RIGHT GOT=RIGHT GetSystemMetrics(23)=0
two program calls, both SPI_SETMOUSEBUTTONSWAP failed, exit code 1, no approval event
native run dsh-20261107T145936-11531616 shows the same independent panel turning red after swap

effect.en: The independent Arena panel turns red with SENT=RIGHT and GOT=LEFT after mouse-button swap is turned on.
effect.zh-CN: 鼠标按键对调打开后，独立 Arena 面板变为红色，SENT=RIGHT、GOT=LEFT。
